neighbours.label: procedural how-to instructions (crafting / recipes): fires on the object or verb after an imperative step ('Place it', 'is then added')
fire: Glue the bases to the board. Place it in the centre and press down.
Mash together until well combined. Place into a muffin tin and bake.
This mixture is then added to the casserole dish over the top.
Cut the card in half and fold it along the dotted line.
Whisk the eggs and pour them into the hot pan.
Sand the edges, then attach it to the frame with screws.
Stir in the flour and transfer the dough to a floured surface.
Thread the needle and push it through both layers of fabric.
quiet: The board was old and the glue had dried long before we arrived.
The muffins were combined into one order and sold by noon.
The casserole dish was a gift from her grandmother years ago.
The card arrived late and the envelope was torn along one edge.
The eggs at the market were expensive this week.
The frame on the wall was crooked and nobody noticed.
The bakery on the corner sells bread with too much flour.
The fabric shop closed early because of the storm.
